inventory.publicFallback: Use the official Spanish DGT DATEX II energy-infrastructure feed as the primary nominative CPO inventory fallback because it exposes operator names per charging site. REVE /api/public/v1 may enrich status/tariffs but is undocumented/unsupported and must remain optional/conservative.
inventory.dgtFallbackEvidence: DGT NAP publishes the national electric-vehicle charging dataset in DATEX II v3 with MITERD as data owner and DGT as publisher. The live directory exposes electrolineras.xml. @gasolinaradar/dgt-ev-collector 1.5.1 independently documents streaming this official feed and extracting operator.name. REVE /api/public/v1 remains unsupported and optional only.
inventory.revePublicObservedScale: Current REVE-derived mirror reports 44,171 public charging points, 13,648 locations and 618 operator labels as of 2026-08-18. Use 618 only as the working operator-label inventory count, not as an authoritative direct-API CPO denominator because aliases/platform identities may be present.
inventory.currentRunInventoryNote: The official DGT directory is live and current, but the 82+ MB XML still cannot be downloaded from the current execution environment. Do not repeat the identical direct-download route without a new transport path. The current REVE-derived public mirror is useful to enumerate/prioritize operator labels; never use its average/observed tariffs as pricing authority.

validatedNamed: Interparking España / P-APP & WEB Servicios Digitales
consistencyNote: The repository now reconciles 17 fully source-validated CPOs by name and preserves the historical gap of 10 earlier validated names instead of guessing them. Electra direct is validated for the Spain-wide ad-hoc bank-card terminal tariff only; Electra app/Autocharge pricing remains station-dependent and must stay dynamic/fail-closed. Plenergy is newly active because official station pages expose exact per-station Precio KW values for some sites and blanks for others. Tesla Supercharger, Feníe Energía public charging, PowerGo, Powy, Naturgy public charging and Plenergy remain active because exact national station/EVSE tariff coverage is incomplete.

active.name: Tesla Supercharger
active.status: official national station inventory complete at 105 entries; exact station/time/vehicle-class tariff coverage remains 1/105 (Córdoba location 4002559). Repeated public station-page probing has not exposed numeric tariffs for the other stations; do not repeat the same investigation again without a new official/guest tariff surface.

active.name: Feníe Energía public charging
active.status: official station-level pricing path confirmed at recarga.fenieenergia.es/punto-recarga/{id}. Seven exact station examples are seeded, demonstrating site-specific prices from 0.15 to 0.50 EUR/kWh plus optional session fees. Continue station inventory/enumeration; never generalize by power or network name.

active.name: PowerGo
active.status: official locations-and-tariffs surface exposes exact station prices and PowerGo states tariffs are dynamic. Two Spanish stations are seeded (+B Energías Sueca and Selwo Aventura). Continue Spanish station enumeration and preserve payment-channel surcharges separately.

active.name: Powy
active.status: official Spain surface states charging prices vary by operator/location and are shown before charging. Powy also documents direct QR payment without registration, creating a plausible guest exact-price path. Exact Spanish station/EVSE QR identifiers are not yet enumerated, so do not promote generic or Italian tariffs; next useful step is station/QR enumeration or a public guest backend discovered from those QR links.

active.name: Naturgy public charging
active.status: current NATURGY RECARGA public app listing confirms a public-charging app backed by Etecnic with charger and plug selection; legacy easyRecarga explicitly exposed tariffs per charging point and connector. Current Naturgy web pages do not expose deterministic public-network prices, and the current app description does not prove the tariff field is still exposed. Keep active pending confirmation of the current app/backend tariff field; never reuse legacy prices or generic public-charging estimates.

active.name: Plenergy
active.status: official Plenergy/legacy Plenoil station pages expose a station-level electric-charger Precio KW field. Seven numeric official examples are seeded (including 0.36 EUR/kWh and one 0.70 EUR/kWh site), while other current station pages expose the field blank. Continue enumerating exact station pages and ingest only currently numeric values; never generalize any observed price network-wide.

excludedNonCpoOrPlatform.name: EVcharge / Etecnic
excludedNonCpoOrPlatform.reason: Official EVcharge/Etecnic material describes a charge-point management SaaS/platform used by municipalities, companies and other operators, with customer-configurable tariffs by time, power and user group. Do not count the platform name itself as a physical CPO or propagate one tariff across stations unless a specific station's physical operator is independently identified.

excludedNonCpoOrPlatform.name: Electromaps / Electromaps SL
excludedNonCpoOrPlatform.reason: Electromaps' current official FAQ states charging tariffs are set by the station owner or CPO, may vary by kWh/minute/fixed fee, and Electromaps can add its own service surcharge. Treat Electromaps as an eMSP/aggregation platform for tariff purposes, not as a physical CPO identity to which one direct tariff can be propagated. Resolve the underlying physical CPO per station/EVSE instead.
